A Wall Street Journal live-market excerpt describes technology shares retreating after the previous day's rally around Huang's return. The 3:53 p.m. ET update reports the Nasdaq down more than 1% and Anthropic down about 9%, while questioning whether data-center spending will earn adequate returns.

This is one timestamped live-coverage entry, not the full day's closing report or a controlled account of market causation. It also reports Huang addressing staff about conduct and therapy; those details remain attributed to the outlet. Short-term prices and capital-spending uncertainty do not determine a final verdict on AI technology or investment returns.
highlights: Reported declines follow a prior-day rebound
Capital spending and returns remain open questions
Only the accessible live-coverage entry was read
No closing price or return prediction is supplied
